answer.reason: The Chebar is where Ezekiel saw visions of God and the word of the LORD came to him, which the summary does not state.

clauses.english: was where the heavens opened and Ezekiel saw visions of God among the captives
clauses.quote: the heavens were opened, and I saw visions of God

doubts: EZK 10:15, 10:20, 10:22 and 43:3 only refer back to the vision seen at Chebar, so they were not cited separately.
EZK 3:15 gives the captives dwelling there, which the summary already covers.
